args:
# Shared MCP may omit BOTRELAY_PYTHON in the environment. $1 is that value
# as its own argv so Cursor can expand it without rewriting this script.
# Never print API keys or vault keys.
is_missing() {
  case "${1:-}" in
    ""|*'${'*) return 0 ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}
expand_tilde() {
  case "${1:-}" in
    "~/"*) printf '%s\n' "${HOME:-}/${1#"~/"}" ;;
    *) printf '%s\n' "${1:-}" ;;
  esac
}
try_configured() {
  if is_missing "${1:-}"; then
    return 1
  fi
  expanded="$(expand_tilde "$1")"
  if [ -n "$expanded" ] && [ -x "$expanded" ]; then
    exec "$expanded" -m botrelay_mcp
  fi
  echo "BotRelay: BOTRELAY_PYTHON is not executable; trying other interpreters." >&2
  return 1
}
try_import_py() {
  if [ -n "${1:-}" ] && [ -x "$1" ] && "$1" -c 'import botrelay_mcp' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exec "$1" -m botrelay_mcp
  fi
  return 1
}
try_configured "${1:-}" || true
env_py="$(printenv BOTRELAY_PYTHON 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ "$env_py" != "${1:-}" ]; then
  try_configured "$env_py" || true
fi
for candidate in \
  "${HOME:-}/.venvs/botrelay/bin/python3" \
  "${HOME:-}/.venvs/botrelay/bin/python" \
  "${HOME:-}/.venvs/botrelay/Scripts/python.exe"
do
  try_import_py "$candidate" || true
done
if command -v botrelay-mcp >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exec botrelay-mcp
fi
for candidate in python3 python; do
  if command -v "$candidate" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$candidate" -c 'import botrelay_mcp' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exec "$candidate" -m botrelay_mcp
  fi
done
echo "BotRelay MCP could not find a Python that imports botrelay_mcp." >&2
echo "Shared MCP often has no botrelay-mcp on PATH and may not receive BOTRELAY_PYTHON." >&2
echo 'Install with: python3 -m venv "$HOME/.venvs/botrelay" && "$HOME/.venvs/botrelay/bin/pip" install botrelay-mcp' >&2
echo "Or set BOTRELAY_PYTHON under Plugins → Configure to that venv's python." >&2
exit 1
